rationale: The agent executed an exchange without first confirming the action with the user, which violates the requirement to confirm every order-changing write. The user’s request prioritized getting the maximum size and specified exchanging only if a new order could not be placed; the agent did not attempt or discuss placing a new order, nor did it explain any limitation. While tool call stubs suggest user/order/product lookups and an exchange were performed, the transcript provides no explicit confirmation step or proof the details (30ml to 100ml, $10.48 refund to PayPal) are supported by tool results. Acting without explicit confirmation and not following the user’s conditional preference leads to a policy failure.
